512-2085-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.

If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5231-5662--5--195.description:

When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.

Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3398-7903.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Dwarves that don't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
3398-7903.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and four Dwarves as attackers. Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the four Dwarves. Thorin's first ability triggers four times, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Hellkite Charger and four Dwarves as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers. Holding priority, activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
3398-7903.notes: If an opponent controls a battle, you can deal damage to that battle instead if desired.

Repeat from step 4.

When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.

the Identity Thief token will deal combat damage as a copy of Medomai the Ageless, granting you an extra turn.
